name: Shikoku Kasei Holdings Corporation
summary: Shikoku Kasei Holdings Corporation engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of chemical products and housing materials in Japan and internationally. It offers carbon disulfide and hydrogen sulfide, sodium sulfate and carbonate, insoluble sulfur, and chlorinated isocyanurates; organic solderability preservative; chemical adhesion process; microetching solution; imidazole type and adduct type latent curing agents; adhesion and heat resistance improver; isocyanuric acid derivatives; glycoluril derivatives; cationic curing materials; and THEIC materials.
